freeze: Protocol and seeds committed before consistency-gated learner implementation and tests.
scientific_question: Does internally cross-validated archive eligibility mitigate contaminated mixed-rule memory chunks during fast A->B->A recovery?
simulator: Unchanged engineered two-numeric-observation ObservableWorld route vs route-reversed, not unfamiliar-family generalization.
interventions: External independent seeded random first-action simulated actor provides all TRAIN outcomes; actor-caused harm counted once, no learner-initiated training actions.

candidate_method.internal_cross_validation: Train one 5NN model on first 32 events and evaluate the other 32; reverse and average 64 held-out event log-likelihoods. Exclude a complete archive chunk when mean held-out log likelihood is below -1.5.
candidate_method.recent_candidate: 8 events immediately before the scoring tail; scoring tail never enters any candidate model.
candidate_method.scoring: Mean log likelihood from event feedback with 0.05 Laplace smoothing; tie break favors earliest archive, no source phase or domain labels.
candidate_method.near_tie_recent_preference: If recent candidate is within 0.75 total log-likelihood points of best candidate, prefer recent candidate. This is an engineered recency bias with possible forgetting regressions.
candidate_method.chunk_quarantine: Quarantine is selection-only. No events or previous successful experiments deleted; candidates can be reconsidered at later checkpoints.
candidate_method.checkpoint: Replay-exact versioned SHA256 with bounded 1000-sample event history; independent read-only tests after restart.

acceptance: Improve B48 against fast retrieval and protect return-A 48 from wrong archive without materially degrading B12, B160 or return-A 4/8. Compare to strong recent-8 baseline; no blanket claim of superiority if it wins.
limitations: Six new seeds inspected after evaluation, never claim continued blindness
Out-of-sample internal CV is NOT source authenticity
Untrusted colluding observations can still be internally consistent
Some physical action consequences remain hazardous despite simulation-only boundaries
Not AthenZ/Synveil or autonomous goals, remain optional draft
